speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: What is announced?
premises: Now the child-initiation rite.
inference: The topic: putrakadīkṣāvidhi — child-initiation rite declared.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: How is it sourced?
premises: It is expanded, determined from the Tantrāloka.
inference: The rite's expansion derives from Tantrāloka — authority by derivation.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: How is it presented here?
premises: But it is stated condensed.
inference: Condensed restatement (saṃkṣipta) for this manual's use.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: What is the third-day mandala-worship order?
premises: Samaya-ending rite on the third day; group-sacrifice in trident-lotus mandala; outer-retinue + door-deity-wheel outside; from Aiśa-corner to Agneya in row-order: Gaṇapati, gurus, parameṣṭhin, former-teachers, yoginī-wheel, Vāgīśvarī, Kṣetrapāla.
inference: The pūjā-krama: three-day samaya-close, then sequential deity-installation from Aiśa to āgneya.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: Where do the three Parās stand?
premises: Whole path placed trident-root to white-lotus; middle-axis Śrīparābhaṭṭārikā with Bhairavanatha, left Śrīmadaparā, right Śrīparāparā; right-trident-middle Śrīmadaparā, left-trident-middle Śrīparāparā — two each in their own places.
inference: The triśūla-axis placement of the three Parā-deities (bhagavatī + Bhairavanātha + apāra-parā pairs), each on its axis.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: What does all-place-enshrinement do?
premises: Thus by all-place-enshrinement of the Goddess, all becomes complete from her enshrinement — thus.
inference: Tathāvidha sarvasthāna-adhiṣṭhātṛtva: everything becomes pūrṇa from the Goddess's enshrinement.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: What of the middle-axis wheel?
premises: Then in the middle-trident's middle-axis, whole deity-wheel to lokapāla-missile worshipped by non-difference-alone; from its enshrinement, worshipped everywhere.
inference: The devatā-cakra on the middle axis is worshipped abhinnatayā; its enshrinement extends pūjā everywhere.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: What is the five-ground conjunction?
premises: In pot, kalasa, mandala, fire, own-self — by non-difference-contemplation join the five-grounds; then special-worship by the Lord two-nature-juice's flowers and rest.
inference: Pañcādhikaraṇa-saṃdhi: five vessels joined by abhedabhāvanā, then viśeṣa-pūjā with puṣpādi enriched by parameśvara-advaya-rasa.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: Why is wealth-deception excluded?
premises: Why bother? Complete with satisfaction-food-offering, without wealth-deception — let him make the sacrifice-place.
inference: The yāgasthāna must be tarpaṇa-naivedya-paripūrṇa and vitta-śāṭhya-virahita — no fraud in funding.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: When is the great-mandala-sacrifice forbidden?
premises: In non-being wealth, the great-mandala-sacrifice is not to be done — indeed.
inference: Mahā-maṇḍala-yāga requires actual wealth (asati vitte); without it, na kartavya eva.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: What about animals?
premises: And living animals let him offer.
inference: Jīvataḥ paśūn nivedayet — living animals are offered (the paśu-rite licensed).

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: Why not doubt the animal-rite?
premises: They too become graced thus — by compassion in the animal-rite one should not doubt.
inference: Kāruṇikatayā: even paśus are anugrītā — the rite benefits them; no doubt (na vicikitset).

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: What follows the paśu-offering?
premises: Fire: Supreme-Lord satisfied by sesame-ghee; another animal for vapa-hom; deity-wheel satisfied by its fat; mandala worshipped again; approaching the Lord, contemplating self all-six-path-complete, the disciple placed in front.
inference: The vapa-homārtha sequence: saṃtaraṇa → paśu-vapa → devatā-cakra-tarpaṇa → maṇḍala → parameśvara-vijñāpana → self-contemplation → disciple placed.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: What is contemplated for parokṣa-dīkṣā?
premises: In indirect initiation, of-living-dead-form, contemplate him in front — or establish a darba-cow-dung likeness in front.
inference: Jīvan-mūrta or pratikṛti: the (dead) disciple contemplated or represented before the rite.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: How is the disciple prepared?
premises: Such a disciple — sprinkled with offering-drops, worshipped by flowers — the whole path placed in his body.
inference: Argha-pātra-prokṣaṇa + puṣpa-pūjā, then samastam adhvānaṃ taddehe nyaset — path installed in the disciple's body.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: What does the teacher consider for a bhogecchu?
premises: Then thus let him consider: for the enjoyment-seeker, the auspicious — let him not cleanse.
inference: For the bhogeccha, the śubha is NOT to be purified (na śodhayet) — desire left intact.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: What about the mumukṣu?
premises: For the liberation-seeker, the auspicious-and-unauspicious — both even.
inference: For mumukṣu both śubha-aśubha are handled (ubhayam api) — full purification.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: What is the nirbījā rule?
premises: In the seedless, covenant-nooses also cleansed; she is for near-death, even most-foolish — the Lord's command; attainment for him by mere teacher-deity-fire devotion-faith.
inference: Nirbījā dīkṣā cleanses samaya-pāśas even for mūḍha (Lord's ājñā); siddhi by guru-devatā-agni-bhakti-niṣṭha alone.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: What distinguishes the mantras?
premises: Herein everywhere habit-capture is the distinguishing [factor], by habit-conformity — from that-and-that work-doing.
inference: Vāsanā-grahaṇam is the bhedaka: mantra-efficacy follows vāsanā-conformity (tattatkārya-kāritva).

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: How is the whole path cleansed?
premises: Having traced habit-distinction, by main-mantra-consideration-special, the path in-own-body, by Siva-two-nature-contemplation.
inference: Anusaṃdhāya-vāsanābheda → mukhya-mantra-parāmarśa-viśeṣa + śivādvaya-bhāvanā = svadeha-gata-adhvan-śodhanā.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: What is the disciple's transformation?
premises: From foot-thumb to twelve-end, disciple-body-consciousness made non-different from self-body-consciousness — right-there, in infinite-bliss-lake, freedom-sovereignty essence, Lord of the deity-wheel, world-manḍala — by union in such form with disciple-self, one becomes, rest attained; thus non-different from the Lord.
inference: The climax: pāda-aṅguṣṭha-to-dvādaśānta identity-attainment — śiṣya-caitanya abhinnī-kṛta with self-caitanya, viśrānti in the anantānanda-sarovara — parameśvara-abhinna bhavati.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: How is an enjoyment-seeker joined?
premises: If enjoyment-seeker: where in-tattva his desire becomes, right-there by whole-and-scattered-manner join.
inference: Bhogeccha-tattva-yojana: join at exactly the tattva where desire stands, samasta-vyasta-tayā.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: What is the final body?
premises: Thereafter for residual-function, from the Lord's nature, suddenly emerged, made-of-pure-tattva body contemplate — thus this all-noose-releasing initiation.
inference: The śeṣa-vṛtti body: jhaṭiti-prasṛta, śuddhatattva-maya — this dīkṣā is the samasta-pāśa-vyojikā.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: How does the disciple close?
premises: Then the disciple the guru by fees, as-before, let worship.
inference: Guru-pūjā with dakṣiṇā, pūrvavat — the closing courtesy.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: What is the disciple's fire-rite?
premises: In fire the disciple's rite: Sri-Para-mantra — so-and-so's so-and-so tattva I-purify — ending-with-svaha, three oblations per tattva, complete ending-with-vausad at end.
inference: The śiṣya-homa: pratitattva tri-āhuti with svāhānta, pūrṇā vauṣaḍantā — per-tattva purification formula.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: What completes the tattva-purification?
premises: Thus Siva-end-tattva-purification; then by-yojanika-told-order full-offering.
inference: Śivānta-tattva-śuddhi closed, then pūrṇāhuti by the yojanika-described order.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: Which offerings for which seeker?
premises: For the enjoyment-seeker, in the enjoyment-place, for-yojanika one [offering]; another for pure-tattva-creation, one-more.
inference: Two pūrṇāhutis: bhogeccha's for yojanā in bhoga-sthāna; the other for śuddhatattva-sṛṣṭi.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: How does the rite end?
premises: Then worship of the guru by fees — thus this child-initiation.
inference: Guru-dakṣiṇā-pūjana closes: ity eṣā putrakadīkṣā — the rite names itself at the end.

speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
question: What gets purified?
premises: In-which ongoing one [tattva] — having-excluded past and future — act is purified.
inference: The seal: vartamāna-eka-varjita-bhūta-bhaviṣyat-karma-śuddhi — ongoing tattva purified of past/future acts.
